mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_run (idempotency_key, run_type, mode) VALUES (#{idempotencyKey}, #{runType}, #{mode}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM analysis_run WHERE sync_request_id = #{syncRequestId} AND attempt_no = #{attemptNo}
SELECT * FROM analysis_run WHERE backfill_request_id = #{backfillRequestId} AND attempt_no = #{attemptNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_run SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED'
UPDATE analysis_run SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE analysis_run SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_detail = #{failureDetail} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE analysis_run SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_detail = #{failureDetail} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) - INTERVAL #{micros} MICROSECOND
